title: Proactive AI Follow-ups
description: FollowupScheduler service that runs hourly, finds warm/hot contacts with no interaction in 48+ hours, and sends personalized AI-generated follow-up messages via WhatsApp. Messages are generated using conversation history for context-aware re-engagement.
features: Hourly check for stale warm/hot contacts (48h threshold)
Max 20 follow-ups per run to prevent spam
Personalized messages using contact context + conversation history
Different follow-up strategies for BUYER_TENANT vs SELLER_LANDLORD
Creates TaskFollowup records to prevent duplicate follow-ups
Logs all follow-up interactions in SSOT
